## Summary

Describe what changed and why. Link the related issue or discussion for substantial changes.

## Change type

- [ ] Plugin or plugin behavior
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation or examples
- [ ] Tests or tooling
- [ ] Core behavior, public interface, or configuration
- [ ] Other (describe):

## Compatibility and impact

Describe any effects on CPU or device behavior, CLI/configuration, public interfaces, experiment
results, or reproducibility. Write “None” when there are no effects.

## License and citations

Identify any new third-party code or dependencies and their licenses. Say whether notices or
research citation details need updating.

## Validation

List the builds, tests, or other checks run and their results. If not run, explain why.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] New behavior has semantic tests where appropriate.
- [ ] Support/compliance information is updated when relevant.
- [ ] Third-party sources, licenses, and required notices are documented when relevant.
- [ ] Citation metadata or research references are updated when relevant.
- [ ] I have disclosed known limitations or compatibility changes.
